pseudocode: if topK<=0 or syllables empty: return empty
if length < 1 or length > 5: return empty
effectiveTopK = min(topK, 1)  // hard max 2 only if explicitly requested later; default 1
filter: enabled, word.length===1, prior>0, prior>=caller minPrior applied downstream
if tone_exact available: keep tone_exact winners only, cap 1
else if surfaceText exact match unique among baseHits: keep that one
else if plain pinyin unique after prior/enabled filter: keep that one
map hits with recallCandidateKind=exact_base; no domain merge
existing flow unchanged (fuzzy optional, collectTier base+domain+idiom, etc.)

parameters.callSiteHint: recallTopKForWindows should pass exactTopK=1 for syllableLength===1 so cache key matches cap

candidateShape.note: WindowCandidate has source: GraphEdgeSource, not a domain field named domain

candidateCapLocation.secondary: recallTopKForWindows passes exactTopK=1 for len=1 (cache key + diagnostics)
candidateCapLocation.reject: C post-truncation alone (wastes SQL; unstable if SQL returns >1 then truncate without ambiguity rule)

tonePlainPolicy.plainAmbiguousCountGt1: return none — do not Top1 guess
